title: The cent went out on Tuesday and the signed CEP came back before the run closed
notes: The beat the whole CEP control exists for, in the order it actually happens. The instruction arrived on a new account and the line read precaucion. Somebody sent the one-cent SPEI, Banxico signed the CEP, the holder matched the razon social on the CFDI, and the account entered the registry while the run was still open. Same payment, same week, and now nothing is open on it. A case that only ever shows an account verified weeks earlier never tests the transition, which is the part a judge watches.
